In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
In those days again, when there was a great mass of people and they had no food, he made his disciples come to him and said to them,
那時，又有許多人聚集，並沒有甚麼吃的。耶穌叫門徒來，說：
“I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
I have pity for these people because they have been with me now three days, and have no food;
「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裡已經三天，也沒有吃的了。
If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”
If I send them away to their houses with no food, they will be overcome by weariness on the way; and some of them have come from far.
我若打發他們餓著回家，就必在路上困乏，因為其中有從遠處來的。」
His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”
And his disciples said in answer, How will it be possible to get enough bread for these men here in a waste place?
門徒回答說：「在這野地，從哪裡能得餅，叫這些人吃飽呢？」
“How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
And he put the question, How much bread have you? And they said, Seven cakes.
耶穌問他們說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「七個。」

And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then He took the seven loaves, gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And they distributed them to the crowd.
And he made the people be seated on the earth: and he took the seven cakes and, having given praise, he gave the broken bread to his disciples to put before them; and they put it before the people.
他吩咐眾人坐在地上，就拿著這七個餅祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，門徒就擺在眾人面前。
They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.
And they had some small fishes; and blessing them he had them put before the people in the same way.
又有幾條小魚；耶穌祝了福，就吩咐也擺在眾人面前。
The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
And they took the food, and had enough; and they took up seven baskets full of the broken bits.
眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
And about four thousand men were present. As soon as Jesus had dismissed the crowd,
And there were about four thousand people: and he sent them away.
人數約有四千。耶穌打發他們走了，
He got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
And he got into the boat with his disciples straight away, and came into the country of Dalmanutha.
隨即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。
Then the Pharisees came and began to argue with Jesus, testing Him by demanding from Him a sign from heaven.
And the Pharisees came out and put questions to him, requesting from him a sign from heaven, testing him.
法利賽人出來盤問耶穌，求他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看，想要試探他。
Jesus sighed deeply in His spirit and said, “Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
And he was very sad in spirit, and said, Why is this generation looking for a sign? truly, I say to you, No sign will be given to this generation.
耶穌心裡深深地歎息，說：「這世代為甚麼求神蹟呢？我實在告訴你們，沒有神蹟給這世代看。」
And He left them, got back into the boat, and crossed to the other side.
And he went away from them, and again got into the boat and went across to the other side.
他就離開他們，又上船往海那邊去了。
Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
And they had taken no thought to get bread; and they had only one cake of bread with them in the boat.
門徒忘了帶餅；在船上除了一個餅，沒有別的食物。
“Watch out!” He cautioned them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
And he said to them, Take care to be on the watch against the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.
耶穌囑咐他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人的酵和希律的酵。」
So they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.
And they said to one another, We have no bread.
他們彼此議論說：「這是因為我們沒有餅吧。」
Aware of their conversation, Jesus asked them, “Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Do you have such hard hearts?
And Jesus, hearing it, said to them, Why are you reasoning among yourselves because you have no bread? do you still not see, and is it still not clear to you? are your hearts so hard?
耶穌看出來，就說：「你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論呢？你們還不省悟，還不明白嗎？你們的心還是愚頑嗎？
‘Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear?’ And do you not remember?
Having eyes, do you not see? and having ears, have you no hearing? and have you no memory?
你們有眼睛，看不見嗎？有耳朵，聽不見嗎？也不記得嗎？
When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Twelve,” they answered.
When I made a division of the five cakes of bread among the five thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? They said to him, Twelve.
我擘開那五個餅分給五千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少籃子呢？」他們說：「十二個。」
“And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Seven,” they said.
And when the seven among the four thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? And they said to him, Seven.
「又擘開那七個餅分給四千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少筐子呢？」他們說：「七個。」
Then He asked them, “Do you still not understand?”
And he said to them, Is it still not clear to you?
耶穌說：「你們還是不明白嗎？」
When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
And they came to Beth-saida. And they took a blind man to him, requesting him to put his hands on him.
他們來到伯賽大，有人帶一個瞎子來，求耶穌摸他。
So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.
And he took the blind man by the hand, and went with him out of the town; and when he had put water from his mouth on his eyes, and put his hands on him, he said, Do you see anything?
耶穌拉著瞎子的手，領他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他說：「你看見甚麼了？」
The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”
And looking up, he said, I see men; I see them like trees, walking.
他就抬頭一看，說：「我看見人了；他們好像樹木，並且行走。」
Once again Jesus placed His hands on the man’s eyes, and when he opened them his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.
Then again he put his hands on his eyes; and looking hard, he was able to see, and saw all things clearly.
隨後又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就復了原，樣樣都看得清楚了。
Jesus sent him home and said, “Do not go back into the village.”
And he sent him away to his house, saying, Do not even go into the town.
耶穌打發他回家，說：「連這村子你也不要進去。」
Then Jesus and His disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say I am?”
And Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the little towns round Caesarea Philippi; and on the way he put a question to his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I am?
耶穌和門徒出去，往凱撒利亞•腓立比村莊去；在路上問門徒說：「人說我是誰？」
They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
And they made answer, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.
他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是先知裡的一位。」
“But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
And he said to them, But who do you say I am? Peter said in answer, You are the Christ.
又問他們說：「你們說我是誰？」彼得回答說：「你是基督。」
And Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about Him.
And he put them under orders not to say this of him to anyone.
耶穌就禁戒他們，不要告訴人。
Then He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and after three days rise again.

And teaching them, he said that the Son of man would have to undergo much, and be hated by those in authority, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be put to death, and after three days come back from the dead.
從此，他教訓他們說：「人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，過三天復活。」
He spoke this message quite frankly, and Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
And he said this openly. And Peter took him, and was protesting.
耶穌明明地說這話，彼得就拉著他，勸他。
But Jesus, turning and looking at His disciples, rebuked Peter and said, “Get behind Me, Satan! For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
But he, turning about, and seeing his disciples, said sharply to Peter, Get out of my way, Satan: for your mind is not on the things of God, but on the things of men.
耶穌轉過來，看著門徒，就責備彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！因為你不體貼神的意思，只體貼人的意思。」
Then Jesus called the crowd to Him along with His disciples, and He told them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
And turning to the mass of people with his disciples, he said to them, If any man has the desire to come after me, let him give up all other desires, and take up his cross and come after me.
於是叫眾人和門徒來，對他們說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.
Whoever has a desire to keep his life, will have it taken from him; and whoever gives up his life because of me and the good news, will keep it.
因為，凡要救自己生命（或譯：靈魂；下同）的，必喪掉生命；凡為我和福音喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?
What profit has a man if he gets all the world with the loss of his life?
人就是賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？
Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
And what would a man give in exchange for his life?
人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

Whoever has a feeling of shame because of me and my words in this false and evil generation, the Son of man will have a feeling of shame because of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
凡在這淫亂罪惡的世代，把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在他父的榮耀裡，同聖天使降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。」
